name: Thick Pelt scales its damage reduction with melee AP and ignores the Bloodmage's own swings (#2325, #4709)
contract: Thick Pelt's active 704626 tooltip uses $556233m1 + 20% of melee AP. At AP 95, that reports reduction 4. Helper 556233 has a physical MOD_DAMAGE_TAKEN base amount of -15 (BasePoints -16 plus DieSides 1), so the server amount is the negative of that displayed reduction: 15 - 20% of the applying Bloodmage's BASE_ATTACK power, clamped at zero. The reported tooltip value and required negative damage-taken sign support that formula; the helper's own 25% tooltip conflicts. Spell.dbc gives 704626 ProcFlags 0x4 (PROC_FLAG_DONE_MELEE_AUTO_ATTACK), so the spell_proc override sets it to 680 (taken physical melee/ranged events). This scenario checks that a level-1 Bloodmage at 21 AP gets amount zero and a level-80 Bloodmage with at least 80 AP gets a negative reduction amount. The manifest-matched original DBC has no cooldown; a fan-maintained Build Hub snapshot adds a conflicting 5-second clause, so this change follows the shipped DBC. The aura amount is snapshotted when 556233 applies. The harness fixture creature is passive and cannot attack back, so the incoming proc itself is tested using a hostile player actor.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the level-1 Bloodmage has less than 75 melee AP
DISCRIMINATING: Thick Pelt does not increase damage taken below 75 AP
SETUP: the level-80 Bloodmage has at least 80 melee AP
DISCRIMINATING: Thick Pelt scales to a negative amount at higher AP
SETUP: the Thick Pelt passive is active
Swing at the neutral bag long enough for several auto attacks to land
SETUP: the Bloodmage really did swing, so the next assertion is not vacuous
DISCRIMINATING: the Bloodmage's own swings do not arm Thick Pelt 556233
A hostile player starts incoming melee attacks against the Bloodmage
Allow one incoming hit and another inside the cooldown window
Thick Pelt procs on an incoming physical melee hit
The incoming proc applies the scaled one-hit helper aura
The proc helper keeps the Bloodmage's AP-scaled amount
